mission: BUILD -> TEST -> MEASURE -> LEARN -> MODIFY -> RETEST
scope: FIRST_REAL_PHYSICAL_TEST ARTICLE; exploratory mechanism hardware only; not production-seat validation; no human/occupant testing

authority_refs.execution_rule: Use P0 design intent where explicit; use CAD extraction where geometry is authority-critical; never replace missing evidence with assumptions.

source_state.consequence: The exploratory architecture and test interfaces can be defined, but geometry that changes kinematics, load path, joint alignment, absorber alignment, lock engagement, rebound stops, or fixture safety boundary remains blocked pending authoritative extraction.

CLASS_A.rule: Must come from R4.1/native CAD or controlled drawing.
items: rail centerline spacing and rail mounting datum
absorber interface axis and attachment geometry where it determines engagement kinematics
lock engagement geometry, datum and travel where it determines state transition
rebound-control stop/engagement geometry where it limits travel
primary fixture attachment coordinates that establish boundary conditions
any joint geometry whose axis location or constraint direction changes the mechanism

CLASS_B.rule: May be defined from P0 design intent for exploratory hardware without asserting production equivalence.
items: surrogate/instrumented mass concept in place of occupant geometry

CLASS_C.rule: May be locally adjustable or fixture-controlled, provided adjustment does not silently alter the controlled hypothesis.
items: replaceable module shimming within a controlled datum scheme

CLASS_D.rule: Not required for the first mechanism test.
items: production upholstery/foam details not involved in load path
vehicle integration details outside the defined fixture boundary

fixture_definition.minimum_boundary_condition: Rigid reaction frame reproducing only the intended mechanism boundary conditions; no vehicle crash pulse reproduction in V0
fixture_definition.attachment_points: CAD_EXTRACTION_REQUIRED where attachment coordinates are part of R4.1/P0 load path
fixture_definition.reaction_path: Fixed frame -> defined mechanism reaction interface -> dual rails/carriage -> ride-down module -> controlled moving structure
fixture_definition.constraint_direction: Primary translation constrained/guided along rail axis; rotational DOF only where P0 mechanism explicitly requires it
allowed_DOF: seatback rotation only if defined by P0 mechanism
fixture_definition.load_introduction: Controlled actuator/test-machine input into the mechanism or surrogate boundary; exact loading waveform/rate shall be selected from the dedicated test plan and not inferred as a crash pulse
fixture_definition.inspection_access: Full visual and dimensional access to rails, joints, absorber, lock and rebound interfaces
fixture_definition.instrumentation_access: All sensors, targets, cables and data acquisition interfaces reachable without entering the primary moving/load path
fixture_definition.safety_containment: Physical guarding/containment around moving components and released-energy paths; positive fixture anchorage; remote operation for dynamic tests; test abort capability
fixture_definition.fixture_gate: Do not run dynamic testing until restraint, travel limits, release-energy containment and sensor protection are verified by inspection.

instrumentation_plan.location: in-line with controlled ride-down load path
rigid structural datum near mechanism mass centroid

instrumentation_plan.protection: protected from impact and cable snag

instrumentation_plan.location: critical joint identified in P0 load path
absorber load axis or equivalent calibrated interface

test_matrix.required_observations: free translation, intended rotation only, lock-state indication, absence of unintended DOF
test_matrix.data: position, angle, lock state, inspection record
test_matrix.decision: Any unintended DOF or uncontrolled state transition blocks dynamic testing and triggers geometry/joint correction.

test_matrix.mode: controlled actuator motion; no crash pulse
test_matrix.required_observations: translation trajectory, reaction force, repeatability, guide behavior
test_matrix.decision: Mechanism is identified only when measured translation follows the commanded path without unintended constraint/release events.

test_matrix.required_observations: load transfer path and structural/joint response
test_matrix.decision: Load must be measurable through the intended path; any bypass path or uncontrolled deformation becomes a design issue.

test_matrix.required_observations: engagement onset, absorber force/stroke, load-path continuity
test_matrix.decision: Engagement must be observable and attributable to the intended interface; otherwise stop and correct geometry/alignment.

test_matrix.required_observations: rotation about intended axis, control response, joint deformation
test_matrix.data: angle/time + joint response + force where instrumented
test_matrix.decision: Rotation is accepted as controlled only when unintended coupled DOF are absent and the intended control element affects the measured response.
Every state transition must be recorded and attributable; ambiguous state is a failure of the test article, not a subjective pass.

test_matrix.required_observations: primary motion completion followed by bounded secondary excursion
test_matrix.data: rebound displacement, force/contact state, seatback angle
test_matrix.decision: Rebound-control element must engage only in its intended regime and must not defeat primary motion.

test_matrix.configuration: P0V0-A versus defined replacement module configuration
test_matrix.required_observations: repeatability and measurable response change attributable to the swapped module
test_matrix.data: full synchronized channel set + configuration ID
test_matrix.decision: A module change is considered informative only when the measured change exceeds documented test repeatability/measurement uncertainty from the same setup. No invented threshold is permitted.

baseline.definition: Baseline build using one controlled ride-down/absorber/lock/rebound module set
baseline.rule: Freeze geometry, fastener state, sensor setup and fixture alignment before baseline data collection.

variant.definition: Same article and fixture with exactly one replaceable experimental module changed
variant.rule: Record changed PART_ID, serial/lot, setting, mass properties if affected, and re-zero relevant sensors.

configuration_control.additional_variants: P0V0-C, P0V0-D... only when one controlled change per configuration is documented

assembly_structure.assembly_rule: Install and inspect fixed datum structure first; install moving mechanism second; install replaceable experimental modules third; install/verify sensors last.

BOM: controlled fasteners and joint hardware per authoritative drawings/inspection
controlled instrumentation set per instrumentation plan
safety guarding/containment appropriate to test energy
manufacturing_and_inspection_rules: Every Class-A feature must be released from authoritative geometry before fabrication.
No fabricated number may be back-filled from guesswork.
Critical mating faces, joint axes, absorber axes, lock engagement faces and rail alignment datums require dimensional inspection before assembly.
All structural fasteners require traceable specification and assembly record.
All replaceable modules receive unique configuration/serial identification.
Sensor datums, zero offsets, axis orientation and calibration state are recorded before each configuration baseline.
Any feature marked TBD-BY-CAD, TBD-BY-INSPECTION or TBD-BY-TEST-FIXTURE remains visibly unresolved until that evidence exists.
inspection_checklist: Verify rail spacing/alignment against authoritative CAD/drawing.
Verify carriage running interfaces and free travel.
Verify absorber axis, mount geometry, stroke envelope and positive retention.
Verify seatback pivot axis and allowed rotational DOF.
Verify lock engagement/release geometry and state sensing.
Verify rebound-control direction, stop/engagement condition and travel envelope.
Verify no unintended joint looseness or free DOF.
Verify surrogate mass, CG/inertia against controlled input evidence.
Verify all sensors are accessible, protected, calibrated/verified and zeroed.
Verify fixture anchorage, reaction path, guards, containment and abort provisions.

data_format.channels: time-synchronized raw channels with engineering units and channel definitions
files: photos/video where useful for state/event verification
data_format.rule: Never overwrite raw data. Every processed result must retain lineage to raw data and CONFIG_ID.

acceptance_identification_rules.principle: Evidence-based mechanism identification; no subjective appearance criteria.
acceptance_identification_rules.functional_acceptance: A mechanism function is only accepted for the exploratory objective when the required measured state/trajectory/event is observed and the inspection record shows no disqualifying structural or kinematic anomaly.
acceptance_identification_rules.repeatability: Use repeated baseline runs to characterize setup repeatability before treating a module swap as causal.
acceptance_identification_rules.change_attribution: One controlled module change per configuration; identical fixture/sensor setup wherever possible.
acceptance_identification_rules.r4_1_boundary: If geometry differs materially from R4.1, report result as P0_EXPLORATORY_ONLY and do not claim direct R4.1 validation.

decision_loop.rule: The status must be tied to recorded measurements and inspection evidence; theoretical dislike is not a failure mode and subjective appearance is not a success criterion.

r4_1_correlation_labels.DIRECT_R4.1_RELEVANCE: Use only where the tested geometry/interface is directly traceable to authoritative R4.1 evidence.
r4_1_correlation_labels.P0_EXPLORATORY_ONLY: Use whenever the physical article intentionally deviates from R4.1 geometry/material/packaging in a way that affects correlation.

ready_conditions: All test-critical Class-A geometry above is extracted or otherwise released from authoritative source.
All interfaces and fastener specifications affecting the test are defined.
All replaceable/adjustable modules are identified and their datums are controlled.
Fixture boundary conditions and safety containment are physically defined.
Instrumentation locations, access and protection are implemented.
Unresolved Class-D items are documented as non-blocking.
Every intentional P0 deviation is recorded before fabrication.
build_readiness_gate.non_blocking_unknowns: Production trim, upholstery, vehicle integration and other Class-D details do not block mechanism fabrication.

handoff_instruction_to_manus: EXECUTE fabrication planning and build preparation from this package. Do not redesign the P0 concept. Do not redefine the 14-input contract. Do not infer missing Class-A geometry. Extract authoritative geometry, close the named blockers, then release only the affected components for fabrication.
